chronology.justification: INFERENCE (OpenML does not document the transformation): V3 and V4 look like global ranks of the original UCI timestamp and date-string columns. The file is person-major and NOT in V3 order, so the stream is sorted by V3 and the validator requires Spearman(V3, V4) >= 0.99 between the two encodings as corroboration (observed 0.99999999999998). Post-hoc structural evidence (features and ids only): after sorting by V3, person id changes only 4 times and the four tags interleave on 99.8% of consecutive rows, i.e. each recording sequence is contiguous. V1 (person) is kept as a covariate; V3/V4 are excluded from features.
